subproblem.title: Integer multiplicity from a.e. oriented approximate tangent planes and integer density
subproblem.statement: Hypothesis names: (REP), (MR), (SL) are the exact frozen statements of the DAG theorems cmc_exists_massRepresentation, cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure, cmc_slice_mass_bounds (hypotheses of the selected parent cbr_cycle_isIntegerMultiplicity); (RU) is the exact frozen statement of the sibling cbr_setIntegral_eq_of_integral_eq, (CT) = (T1) ∧ (T2) ∧ (MM) that of cbr_measure_convergence_tools, (RECT) that of cbr_rectifiable_of_approx_tangent; whichever are needed appear verbatim as hypotheses of the Lean statement. In words: (REP) a current T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), U open, with M_W(T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U has a mass representation (μ, ξ): μ(ℝ^P∖U) = 0, μ(K) < ∞ for compact K ⊆ U, μ(W) = M_W(T) for open W, ξ μ-a.e. strongly measurable with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x, α, T(ω) = ∫ξ(ω)dμ, and μ(E) = 0 whenever Hⁿ(E) = 0 provided also M_W(∂T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U; (MR) M_W(T) = R.measure(W) for an IMRep R of T in an open U and open W; (SL) for T ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U) with admissible representations (μ, ξ) of T and (μ', ξ') of ∂T and L-Lipschitz f there are currents A_t, B_t with A_t(ω) = ∫_{f<t}ξ(ω)dμ, B_t(η) = ∫_{f<t}ξ'(η)dμ', ∂A_t = B_t on forms supported off {f = t}, M_W(∂A_t − B_t) ≤ L·liminf_{h↓0}h⁻¹μ(W ∩ {t−h < f < t}) and ∫_a^b M_W(∂A_t − B_t)dt ≤ Lμ(W ∩ {a < f < b}) for open W; (RU) an identity ∫ξ₁(ω)dμ₁ = ∫ξ₂(ω)dμ₂ + ∫ξ₃(ω)dμ₃ between admissible pairs, valid for all test forms on an open U, remains valid with all integrals restricted to any Borel set; (T1) measures μ_j with sup_jμ_j(K) < ∞ on compacts have a subsequence converging to a Radon μ (against C_c, limsup on compacts ≤ μ, liminf on open sets ≥ μ); (T2) if X_j ⇀ X with admissible representations (μ_j, ξ_j), (μ_X, ξ_X), limsup_jμ_j(K) ≤ μ(K) on compacts, f continuous and μ{f = t} = 0, then ∫_{f<t}ξ_j(ω)dμ_j → ∫_{f<t}ξ_X(ω)dμ_X; (MM) if Z_j(t) ≤ L·liminf_{h↓0}h⁻¹μ_j(G ∩ {t−h < f < t}) on (a, b) then some measurable g ≥ liminf_jZ_j a.e. on (a, b) has ∫_a^b g ≤ L·liminf_jμ_j(G ∩ {a < f < b}); (RECT) a Borel M with Hⁿ(M) < ∞ having approximate tangent spaces Q(x) at Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M with x ↦ p_{Q(x)} Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable is countably n-rectifiable. Assume (RECT). Let P, n ∈ ℕ, Γ ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P), M ⊆ ℝ^P Borel with Hⁿ(M) < ∞ (Hⁿ = μHE[n]), θ : ℝ^P → ℝ Borel with θ > 0 on M and ∫_Mθ dHⁿ < ∞ (as ∫⁻_M ofReal θ), ζ : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) strongly measurable, with Γ(ω) = ∫_Mθ(x)ζ(x)(ω(x))dHⁿ(x) for every test n-form ω. Suppose that for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M there is a subspace Q with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q and ζ(x) a unit orientation of Q, and θ(x) is a natural number. Then Γ is integer multiplicity.
subproblem.lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (Q : Euclid P → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), MeasurableSet M → μHE[n] M ≠ ∞ → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (Q x).starProjection) (μHE[n].restrict M) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x (Q x)) → CountablyRectifiable n M) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Γ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (θ : Euclid P → ℝ) (ζ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), MeasurableSet M → μHE[n] M < ∞ → Measurable θ → StronglyMeasurable ζ → (∀ x ∈ M, 0 < θ x) → ∫⁻ x in M, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂μHE[n] < ∞ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, Γ ω = ∫ x in M, θ x * ζ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n]) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (ζ x) Q ∧ ∃ m : ℕ, θ x = m) → IsIntegerMultiplicity Γ
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: parent proof, end of step 9 (measurability of the tangent-plane field) and step 11 (V15, conclusion: rectifiable, then assembly of the IMRep). The accepted DAG lemmas exists_plane_cutoff_quadratic_moment_eq, continuous_blowUp_image_setIntegral, aemeasurable_starProjection_of_aemeasurable_norm_sq and hasApproximateTangentSpaceAt_iff_of_null_sdiff have the same content as steps 2(a), 2(b), 2(d) and 5 below; they are not prerequisites of this node, so the arguments are given in full.
1. Tangent field. Let T_x := approxTangentPlane n M x (the contract's choice of some Q with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q when one exists, ⊥ otherwise) and p_x := T_x.starProjection. Outside an Hⁿ⌞M-null set some Q with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q exists, so HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x T_x (choice specification) and T_x = Q by uniqueness of approximate tangent spaces (SimonGMT HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt.unique); in particular ζ(x) is a unit orientation of T_x there.
2. Measurability of x ↦ p_x for Hⁿ⌞M. (The parent obtains it by writing the plane as a Borel function of τ(x) = θ(x)ζ(x); here the field is approxTangentPlane and the blow-up-integral argument gives the same conclusion.) If n = 0, every T_x has finrank 0, so T_x = ⊥ and p_x ≡ 0. Let n ≥ 1. (a) For u ∈ ℝ^P let f_u(y) := max(1 − |y|², 0)⟨u, y⟩², continuous with compact support. For every n-dimensional subspace Q, ∫_Qf_u dHⁿ = c_n|p_Qu|² with c_n := ∫_{ℝⁿ}max(1 − |z|², 0)z_1²dz ∈ (0, ∞): parametrize Q by a linear isometry ι(z) = Σz_iτ_i (Hⁿ⌞Q = ι_*Lⁿ), so ⟨u, ιz⟩ = Σa_iz_i with a_i = ⟨u, τ_i⟩; the cross terms vanish by the symmetry z_i ↦ −z_i and the diagonal terms equal c_n by z_i ↔ z_1, giving c_nΣa_i² = c_n|p_Qu|². (b) For f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P) and r > 0, Φ_{f,r}(x) := ∫_{blowUpMap x r '' M}f dHⁿ = r^{−n}∫_Mf(r⁻¹(y − x))dHⁿ(y) (Hⁿ(blowUpMap x r '' S) = r^{−n}Hⁿ(S)) is continuous in x by dominated convergence (Hⁿ(M) < ∞, f bounded), hence Borel. (c) Where T_x is an approximate tangent space (Hⁿ⌞M-a.e., step 1), Φ_{f_u,1/(k+1)}(x) → ∫_{T_x}f_u dHⁿ = c_n|p_xu|²; so x ↦ |p_xu|² is an Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. limit of Borel functions, hence Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. measurable (aemeasurable_of_tendsto_metrizable_ae'). (d) By polarization ⟨p_xu, u'⟩ = (|p_x(u + u')|² − |p_x(u − u')|²)/4 (p_x self-adjoint and idempotent), so every matrix entry of p_x is a.e. measurable and x ↦ p_x = Σ_{i,j}⟨p_xe_i, e_j⟩L_{ij} (fixed L_{ij} ∈ L(ℝ^P)) is Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. measurable, hence a.e. strongly measurable (finite-dimensional, second countable codomain).
3. Rectifiability. (RECT) with M and Q(x) := T_x: M is Borel, Hⁿ(M) < ∞, x ↦ p_x is Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable (step 2) and HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x T_x for Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. x (step 1). Hence M is countably n-rectifiable.
4. A Borel carrier of full measure. Let G ⊆ M be the set of x ∈ M at which the hypothesis holds (an approximate tangent space Q at x oriented by ζ(x), and θ(x) ∈ ℕ); Hⁿ(M∖G) = 0. Let N₀ := toMeasurable(Hⁿ, M∖G) (Borel, Hⁿ(N₀) = 0) and M'' := M∖N₀ ⊆ G: Borel with Hⁿ(M∖M'') = 0.
5. Tangent spaces of M''. Hⁿ(M △ M'') = 0, and blowUpMap x r maps Hⁿ-null sets to Hⁿ-null sets (Hⁿ(blowUpMap x r '' S) = r^{−n}Hⁿ(S)), so ∫_{blowUpMap x r '' M''}f dHⁿ = ∫_{blowUpMap x r '' M}f dHⁿ for all x, r > 0, f; hence HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M'' x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q for all x, Q. (The parent uses (IMC)(a) here, which gives the same for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M''.)
6. The IMRep. mult(x) := ⌊θ(x)⌋₊ for x ∈ M'' and 0 otherwise (measurable, ℕ-valued; mult(x) = θ(x) on M'' ⊆ G), orient := ζ. Fields: carrier M'' Borel and ⊆ ℝ^P; countably n-rectifiable by step 3 and CountablyRectifiable.mono (M'' ⊆ M); mult measurable; mult(x) = θ(x) > 0 on M'' (θ(x) ∈ ℕ and θ(x) > 0); local integrability: ∫⁻_{M''∩K}mult dHⁿ ≤ ∫⁻_M ofReal θ dHⁿ < ∞; orient is strongly measurable, hence a.e. strongly measurable for Hⁿ⌞M''; orientation: every x ∈ M'' lies in G, so ζ(x) is a unit orientation of a Q with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q, hence HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M'' x Q (step 5).
7. Representation. For a test form ω: R.action(ω) = ∫_{M''}mult(x)ζ(x)(ω(x))dHⁿ = ∫_{M''}θ(x)ζ(x)(ω(x))dHⁿ = ∫_Mθ(x)ζ(x)(ω(x))dHⁿ = Γ(ω), using Hⁿ(M∖M'') = 0. So R represents Γ and Γ is integer multiplicity. ∎
proof_key_steps: T_x := approxTangentPlane n M x is the hypothesised plane at a.e. x (uniqueness of approximate tangent spaces).
Blow-up integrals of the quadratic test functions f_u make x ↦ |p_{T_x}u|², hence x ↦ p_{T_x}, Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. measurable.
Restrict to a Borel full-measure M'' where θ ∈ ℕ and ζ orients the tangent plane; assemble the IMRep (M'', θ, ζ) representing Γ.
